claims.claim: The contact sheet shows a distinct, visible JVM or Java-platform mechanic for every prompt and no literal Java logo.
claims.evidence: Original-resolution worker inspection and the director's contact-sheet review passed all ten. The sheet shows layered runtime levels; loader gates; verifier court; per-thread towers around a shared heap; generational foundry rails and crane; portable bridges to differing foundations; dense lightweight thread cells; bounded module terraces; cup-like negative-space court with three functional curved vents; and a readable synthesis of these systems. No Java wordmark or literal Java logo appears.
